scope: Primary-source first-play and save-disclosure acceptance research only

primary_sources.title: Patrick's Parabox official site
primary_sources.finding: Explains moving boxes into and out of other boxes; puzzles introduce distinct ideas. Marketing description, not observed first-play results.

primary_sources.title: Patrick's Parabox developer itch page
primary_sources.finding: Lists Windows/macOS/Linux and Keyboard/Gamepad inputs, Japanese translation and a Steam demo link. No browser demo or mobile compatibility inferred.

primary_sources.title: Patrick's Parabox developer Steam page
primary_sources.finding: Demo download and purchase are separately labelled. Demo not downloaded or played.

primary_sources.title: Sokobond Express official site
primary_sources.finding: States chemistry experience is unnecessary and links purchase platforms. Statement is positioning, not evidence of user comprehension.

primary_sources.title: Sokobond Express publisher itch page
primary_sources.finding: Describes chemical bonds plus pathfinding and no upfront chemistry knowledge; desktop download platforms are listed. Average-session metadata not treated as measured play time.

primary_sources.title: Puddle Knights creator itch page
primary_sources.finding: Describes arranging capes over puddles so nobles can reach a goal; Windows demo ZIP listed. Not browser-play evidence.

primary_sources.title: Unity 6.3 PlayerPrefs API
primary_sources.finding: Web storage uses IndexedDB and Windows Editor/standalone storage locations differ. API description does not establish persistence of this game.
